facts.text: You play the T side on Inferno.
The bomb has not been planted; about 14 s remain on the round clock.
Your team is carrying the bomb in Arch.
One defender is visible in B site right now with an MP9.
A teammate was killed in B site 0.4 s ago by an MP9.
Your players: AK-47 + Glock-18, 100 HP, full armour; AK-47 + Glock-18, 100 HP, no armour.
Your team has 1 HE grenade left.
Score: your team 4, the defenders 12. A round win ends the match for the defenders.
Your team is positioned: 1 in A site, 1 in Arch.
The positions of two defenders are unknown.

debrief.whyItWorks: With limited clock, taking space while the defence is unsettled is the most reliable way to plant in time. Here, 2 players faced 3 with about 14 seconds left.
debrief.cost: It spends the team's options at once, leaving little for the post-plant.
debrief.assumption: The defenders cannot rotate enough players to the site before the plant.
debrief.breaksWhen: The defence stacks the chosen site and has its own utility ready for the execute.

evidenceReview.explanation: The team had one HE grenade and no smokes, flashes or molotovs. The utility left sets how much of the plan can be forced rather than hoped for.
The round clock stood near 14 seconds. The round clock bounds how long any plan can take.
It was 2 players against 3. The head count sets how many duels the team can lose and still carry out its plan.
The confirmed position of one defender in B site was current. A sighting narrows where contact is likely, but its value falls quickly with age.
Two defenders could not be placed. Unaccounted-for opponents are the main risk to any committed plan and the main reason to gather information.

debrief.followupReview: The proposed best answer to the new information was: Stick to the line you chose. Reasoning: the state is urgent: the round clock is under 15 seconds after the new information, so only a commitment can still plant.
debrief.strongestAlternative: The closest alternative was to save the weapons, conceding the round to keep the economy intact.

counterfactual.changedFact: The defenders are known to be stacked on the site you would hit.
counterfactual.effect: The execute meets a full defence, and taking information or faking becomes stronger.
